data.name: Tactician
data.description: A cavalier receives a teamwork feat (%3) as a bonus feat. He must meet the prerequisites for this feat. As a standard action, the cavalier can grant this feat to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear him. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for %1 rounds. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats. The cavalier can use this ability %2 times per day.|3+CavalierLVL/2|1+CavalierLVL/5|%LIST
